{{Quote|We’d better go to Operation Bodybag, dears. It looks like an assault shuttle just dropped off a scouting patrol.|Silya Darklighter|<ref name="Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}
'''Operation Bodybag''' was the codename used by [[Silya Darklighter]] during a rescue operation conducted by her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] 
[[Jula Darklighter]], to recover former [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], who was lost in the deserts of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The code signaled that Solo's companions&mdash;[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[Sligh]], [[Grees]], and [[Emala]]&mdash;were to hide themselves inside Jula's market [[Skiff/Legends|skiff]] when it was halted for inspection by a squad of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Ghost" />
